description: Emite uma ZK identity attestation no pipa_korea_zk_identity program (PIPA Korea Art. 24 — i-PIN replacement). Requer SP1 v6 Groth16 proof real (356 bytes) + public_inputs (96 bytes) onde public_inputs[32..64] = subject_commitment. 4 kinds: 1=age_gate_19, 2=korean_resident, 3=kyc_verified, 4=domestic_representative.

attributeMetadataHashHex.description: 32-byte hex sha256 dos metadados off-chain (issuance details, validity).

proofHex.description: 356-byte hex SP1 v6 Groth16 proof. Gerar via mesma pipeline que compliance-registry / consent-manager.

publicInputsHex.description: 96-byte hex ABI-encoded PublicValuesStruct. public_inputs[32..64] DEVE ser igual a subjectCommitmentHex.

subjectCommitmentHex.description: 32-byte hex commitment (Poseidon ou sha256 de identity_secret + salt). Sem PII.

name: issue_pipa_zk_identity
